AReading: Working Across Three Time Zones
Read the kick-off email, then choose the correct answer for each question.

Hi team, welcome to Project Atlas! From next week we will be working with colleagues in Bangalore, Dublin and São Paulo, so I would like to share a few ground rules.

First, time zones. Our daily stand-up moves to 13:00 CET — early enough for Brazil and late enough for India. Please keep your calendar up to date so colleagues can see when you are available. Second, video calls. Cameras on for the weekly review, please; it helps to see who is speaking. If your connection is weak, turn the camera off and say your name before you speak.

Third, cultural sensitivity. Direct feedback is normal in Germany, but it can sound harsh to colleagues from other cultures. Ask questions instead of making statements — 'Could you tell me why you chose this approach?' works better than 'This is wrong.' Looking forward to the kick-off on Monday! — Priya
